reconcile.note: Clarke limits the wisdom God vows to destroy to the philosophers' godless learning, not wisdom itself, so the pro-wisdom texts and Paul describe different things.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogs Proverbs' praise of wisdom against Genesis 3:6, Job 37:24, and 1 Corinthians 1:19 as an unresolved contradiction over whether wisdom is prized or condemned.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
sides.verseText: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

sides.snippet: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.
sides.verseText: For it is written, \"I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.\"
